request.description:
Get a JWT access token from Keycloak using client credentials flow (DEV environment).

**Setup Required:**
1. Load .env.notify-dev.json as environment
2. Set Keycloak environment variables:
   - `keycloak_url`: Keycloak instance URL
   - `client_id`: Your OAuth2 client ID
   - `client_secret`: Your OAuth2 client secret

The token will be automatically saved to `{{jwt_token}}` for use in API requests.

request.description:
Get an OAuth2 access token from Kong's OAuth2 plugin (DEV environment with Kong).

**Prerequisites:**
1. Kong is running in DEV environment
2. Load .env.notify-dev.json as environment
3. Set kong_token_url environment variable
4. Kong seed script has created test credentials

**Default Test Credentials (from kong-seed.sh):**
- Client A: client_id=test-client-a, secret=test-client-secret-a-12345678901234567890
- Client B: client_id=test-client-b, secret=test-client-secret-b-98765432109876543210
- Client C: client_id=test-client-c, secret=test-client-secret-c-11111111111111111111

The token will be automatically saved to `{{jwt_token}}` for use in API requests.

Register a callback webhook.

**Setup:**
1. Go to https://webhook.site, copy your unique URL, set it as `webhook_url` collection variable.
2. Send a notification (e.g. Simple Send Email).
3. Watch the POST arrive at webhook.site with `X-Webhook-Signature` header if secret is set.

**Fields:**
- `url`: HTTPS URL to receive POST requests (required)
- `channelType`: filter by channel — `email`, `sms`, `msgApp`. Omit to receive all.
- `trigger`: `success` fires on COMPLETED, `failure` fires on FAILED. Omit to receive all.
- `secret`: Optional. If provided, each POST includes `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hmac>`.
- `headers`: Optional key/value pairs merged into every outbound POST.
- `active`: true/false to enable/disable without deleting.

**callbackId is auto-saved to `{{callback_id}}` collection variable.**

Register a callback with an HMAC secret. Each delivered POST will include `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hmac>` computed over the raw JSON body. Verify on your server with HMAC-SHA256 using the same secret.

Partial update of an existing callback. Only include fields to change.

Example: disable without deleting by setting `"active": false`.
Permanently remove a registered callback. Returns 204 No Content on success.

Cancel a notification that hasn't been delivered yet (service-to-service endpoint).

**Prerequisites:**
- `notification_id`: UUID of the notification to cancel (set {{notification_id}} variable)
- Token must have service-to-service credentials

**Allowed Statuses:**
- pending
- accepted
- scheduled

**Response:**
Returns the updated notification with status changed to 'cancelled'

Reschedule a notification to a new delivery time (service-to-service endpoint).

**Prerequisites:**
- `notification_id`: UUID of the notification to reschedule (set {{notification_id}} variable)
- Token must have service-to-service credentials

**Allowed Statuses:**
- pending
- accepted
- scheduled

**Request Parameters:**
- `scheduledTime`: ISO 8601 datetime (must be in the future)

**Response:**
Returns the updated notification with delayedSendTime changed to the new scheduledTime

Cancel a notification that hasn't been delivered yet (frontend endpoint).

**Prerequisites:**
- `notification_id`: UUID of the notification to cancel (set {{notification_id}} variable)
- Token must have NOTIFY_ADMIN role
- Token must be a frontend user token

**Allowed Statuses:**
- pending
- accepted
- scheduled

**Response:**
Returns the updated notification with status changed to 'cancelled' and updatedBy set to the authenticated user ID

request.description:
Send an email using Bearer token authentication (OAuth2 or JWT) via CHES compatibility endpoint.

**Prerequisites:**
1. Get a token using:
   - "Get JWT Token (Client Credentials)" for Keycloak (dev env)
   - "Get OAuth2 Token (Kong - Local)" for Kong-based dev
2. Token will be automatically used in Authorization header

**Usage:**
- For DEV with Keycloak: Load .env.notify-dev.json
- For LOCAL with Kong: Load .env.notify-local.json with Kong token endpoint

**Email Body Parameters:**
- `from`: Sender email address (required)
- `to`: Array of recipient email addresses (required)
- `cc`: Array of CC recipients (optional)
- `bcc`: Array of BCC recipients (optional)
- `subject`: Email subject (required)
- `body`: Email body content (required)
- `bodyType`: Format of body - "text" or "html"
- `encoding`: Character encoding (optional)
- `priority`: Email priority - "low", "normal", "high"
- `attachments`: Array of attachment objects (optional)
- `tag`: Tag for categorizing email (optional)
- `delayTs`: ISO 8601 datetime to delay sending (optional)
- `mergeData`: Object for template variable substitution (optional)
